source_units.text: Write a personal introduction to an imaginary pen pal.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: The fictional writer collects odd buttons, rides a yellow bicycle, and wants to hear about the smallest adventure in Ren's week.
Mention that the button collection began with a coat pocket discovery.
The text must contain "collecting odd buttons", "a yellow bicycle", "the smallest adventure" verbatim.
Address this to an imaginary new pen pal named Ren.
